title: Anthropic's Q3 revenue is said to hit $16.8 billion ahead of IPO
description: Anthropic reportedly told investors its third-quarter revenue reached about $16.8 billion, up roughly 45% from the prior quarter. People familiar with the matter say it also reached adjusted profitability for the first time. The company is preparing for a potential IPO, with reports pointing to a November listing.

title: Ahead of IPO, Anthropic reveals its revenue grew 45% sequentially to $16.8B in Q3
description: SiliconANGLE reports Anthropic disclosed 45% sequential revenue growth to $16.8 billion in Q3 as it prepares to go public. The figures follow a leaked confidential filing in September that showed rapid growth alongside a large 2025 operating loss.

title: Gemini 4 Argon reaches Gemini app Pro and Ultra subscribers alongside a new tasks mode
description: Google has rolled out Gemini 4 Argon to Gemini app Pro and Ultra subscribers, after an earlier release to vetted cybersecurity defenders. The rollout adds a new tasks mode. Google's chart from the model's unveiling showed it ahead of Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 on DeepSWE v1.1.

title: Microsoft to rely more on homegrown AI chips, reducing dependence on Nvidia
description: Microsoft plans to run most of its AI inference workloads on its own Maia accelerators, starting with the third-generation chip. The move is intended to reduce reliance on Nvidia and lower costs.

title: Security researchers spent 6 days doing their Chromework, built 1B user exploit
description: Security startup Xbow reportedly used OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol to chain three Chrome zero-days into a sandbox-escaping exploit on Windows. Four researchers spent six days and about $40,000 in tokens; Google patched the bugs and paid a $250,000 bounty. The account rests on Xbow's own description.

title: Shares of Oracle, neoclouds drop on CoreWeave debt concerns
description: Shares of Oracle and several AI cloud providers fell on concerns about CoreWeave's debt. The drop highlights investor sensitivity to the financing behind AI data center buildouts.

title: Grok Voice 3.0 from SpaceXSI outscores OpenAI and Google on speech-to-speech index
description: Grok Voice 3.0 reportedly outscores OpenAI and Google models on a speech-to-speech benchmark index. The release is positioned as a step forward for xAI's voice capabilities.
